name: ai-handwritten-notes-app
description: AI Handwritten Notes App - a GoodNotes-style handwriting canvas with an AI tutor embedded in the page.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/backend && npm run build --workspace=apps/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/shared --if-present && npm run test --workspace=apps/backend --if-present && npm run test --workspace=apps/frontend --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/backend --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/frontend --if-present
